read.title: Campaign Brief: Calm Skin Toner Launch
read.text:
Objective: Increase awareness of our new Calm Skin Toner among first-time buyers.

Target audience: Women aged 20 to 30 in the US with sensitive skin.

Key message: Gentle enough for daily use, even on red and irritated skin.

Deliverables: One 30-second Reel and three Stories per creator. Please show the product on bare skin, and keep the tone calm and honest, in line with our brand guide.

Timeline: Submit drafts no later than December 5. Posts go live from December 10.

write.en: Write a short campaign brief summary for influencers, including the objective, key message, and draft deadline.
write.model:
Hi Emma,

Here is a quick summary of our campaign brief. The objective is to introduce our new sun cushion to first-time buyers. The key message is "light coverage with all-day sun protection." Please keep the tone in line with our brand guide and send your draft no later than November 28.

Thanks,
Minsu
